head: conical keps (washer nut), 3/8 hex, .45 OD
notes: AMK lists it as B-13507; the camaros.net hardware list gives AMK B-10475 for it, but both give 10-24 and .45 OD. One AMK snippet also showed a 10-32 keps row near it, probably the next row. Vendors use it for parking lamp studs (63-67 Corvette), battery junction block, and circuit breaker. Both pages are 403/paywalled; quotes come from search snippets.
